_config.stream_algorithm: numpy.SeedSequence(8 entropy uint32 words, HRLD domain, frame, component); NOT keyed by rho or snr

receiver.logloss: mean log2(1+exp(-(1-2b)L)) over 2048 coded bits, L=log P0/P1

environment.torch_binding_authority: receiver context build; verified before first receiver run

cluster_params.delay_cap_rule: redraw whole delay set if max delay > cap (no clipping/stacking)
cluster_params.rays_per_tap: 1 + Poisson(lambda-1) via inverse CDF of ONE per-tap uniform shared across configs
cluster_params.ray_gain: CN(0, tap_power/R); base normals shared across configs; realized sum|g|^2 renormalised to 1
cluster_params.ray_doppler: nu = nu_max cos(theta0_tap + sigma*z) (z ~ N(0,1) shared), or cos(U[0,2pi)) per ray (uniform)
cluster_params.normalisation_note: sum|g|^2 = 1 exactly (NOT production G0 Frobenius normalisation); realized ||H||_F^2/N differs by same-delay ray interference (recorded as cl_energy_per_dim)

f2.ps: native_f1.receive_f1 (PhysicalF1(1024,c1,c2,102).acquire -> time_refine_keep_slots x2 rounds -> scalar_joint joint-gain TF20 -> LDPC50) + CSTATE20 branch iff final syndrome != 0 (run_stage_a.py arm D); PS0 = arm C
f2.ps_slot_budget: max 8 slots (acquire loop range(8), time_refine_keep_slots max_paths=8); bank = 103 delays x 25 Doppler centres (-3..3 step .25); duplicate = same delay and |dnu|<1e-6 only, so >1 slot per delay allowed
f2.oracle: true delays; D sub-paths at power-weighted centroid + (k-(D-1)/2)*1.0 bin; LS gains over n=0..N-1; detection = interventions.run_fixed_channel(detector=tf); misfit = sum_l||a_l-fit_l||^2/sum_l||a_l||^2 (= ||H-H_D||_F^2/||H||_F^2, checked against explicit matrices)
f2.m1_dpss: P_D: true delays; per tap, projection of the true tap sequence onto the first D modulated DPSS (scipy.signal.windows.dpss(N=1024, NW=W, Kmax, sym=True, norm=2)) centred at the power-weighted ray centroid, W = max_r|nu_r-c|+0.5 bins; detection = fixed-H TF20R2 with a GENERAL-TAP operator (tapchannel.py); misfit = sum_l||a_l-a~_l||^2/sum_l||a_l||^2; GX = exact tap sequences on frames%20==0

pairing: all rows of each frame (population: each snr cell frame) share (channel_seed, physical_gains_sha256, info_sha256, noise_sha256)
